_comment: The second press in the Americas (#6559): Lima, Antonio Ricardo 1584 onward. IA advancedsearch on Lima imprints 1584-1625 (66 hits), hand selection, check-holdings on every pick (all new). Single-sheet ordinances skipped.

books.title: Doctrina christiana y catecismo para instrucción de los indios
books.author: Third Council of Lima (Tercer Concilio Limense)
books.note: Lima, Antonio Ricardo, 1584: the first book printed in South America. Trilingual catechism of the Third Council of Lima.

books.title: Confessionario para los curas de indios
books.author: Third Council of Lima (Tercer Concilio Limense)
books.note: Lima, Antonio Ricardo, 1585. Includes the instruction against the rites and ceremonies of the Andean gentiles.

books.title: Arte y vocabulario en la lengua general del Perú llamada quichua y en la lengua española
books.author: Anonymous (attrib. Blas Valera / Antonio Ricardo)
books.note: Lima, Antonio Ricardo, 1586. First Quechua grammar and dictionary printed in Peru.

books.title: Primera parte de Arauco domado
books.author: Pedro de Oña
books.note: Lima, Antonio Ricardo, 1596. Epic by the first Chilean-born poet.

books.title: Libro general de las reducciones de plata y oro de diferentes leyes y pesos
books.author: Juan de Belveder
books.note: Lima, Antonio Ricardo, 1597. Assay tables for Potosí silver.

books.title: Primera parte de la Miscelánea austral
books.author: Diego Dávalos y Figueroa
books.note: Lima, Antonio Ricardo, 1602. Dialogues on love, Petrarchism and the natural world of Peru.

books.title: Doctrina christiana y catecismo en la lengua allentiac
books.author: Luis de Valdivia
books.note: Lima, Francisco del Canto, 1607. The only record of the extinct Allentiac (Huarpe) language.

books.title: Gramática y arte nueva de la lengua general de todo el Perú, llamada lengua qquichua o lengua del Inca
books.author: Diego González Holguín

books.title: Vocabulario de la lengua general de todo el Perú llamada lengua qquichua o del Inca
books.author: Diego González Holguín
books.note: Lima, Francisco del Canto, 1608. The great colonial Quechua dictionary.

books.title: Temblor de Lima año de 1609
books.author: Pedro de Oña
books.note: Lima, Francisco del Canto, 1609. Poem on the 1609 earthquake.

books.title: Arte de la lengua quechua general de los indios de este reino del Pirú
books.author: Alonso de Huerta

books.title: Discurso mathemático sobre los dos cometas que se han parecido este año de 1618
books.author: Antonio Luciano
books.note: Lima 1619. Astronomy and astrological judgement on the comets of 1618.

books.title: Labyrintho de comercio terrestre y naval
books.author: Juan de Hevia Bolaños
books.note: Lima, Francisco del Canto, 1617. Commercial and maritime law of the Indies.

books.title: Historia del célebre santuario de Nuestra Señora de Copacabana
books.author: Alonso Ramos Gavilán
books.note: Lima 1621. Lake Titicaca: Inca sun-island cult, Andean religion and its Christian overwriting.
